extraction: Agentic architectures DAG benefits: (1) Explicit dependencies enable parallel execution. (2) Failure isolation — one node fails, others continue. (3) Reproducibility — DAG + inputs = deterministic. (4) Observability — track progress per node. Our engine DAG: 3 parallel chains (surya, easyocr, paddleocr), each 4-node sequential (Engine→Verdict→Miss→Verdict). Failure in surya chain doesn't block easyocr. DAG in mission.yaml reproducible. Progress tracked per node in LEADERBOARD.md.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: whether DAG architecture provides failure isolation and observability for our campaign
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
